rows.quote: JOSEPH E. ALLEN - Effective Friday, May 21, 1982 Joe began his employment as a night custodian at Lunenburg High School effective May 18, 1977 under the CETA program. On September 12, 1977, the school department continued his employment when his eligibility under CETA expired. On March 20, 1982 he submitted his intent to retire in May after completing five years of service with the school department. Our best wishes
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: ANNE T. BLANCHARD - Effective Wednesday, June 30, 1982 Mrs. Blanchard began her employment as a general worker in the junior-senior high school cafeteria effective September 1, 1969. On May 26, 1982 she submitted her intent to retire effective in June after having served the cafeteria operation for a period of twelve years. Our thanks, Anne, for a job well done.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: JENNIE D. DAVIS - Effective Friday, November 5, 1982 "Jane" submitted her letter of intent to retire after having served the school system for eight years as Payroll Secretary in the Central Office. This was a job she handled very competently and thoroughly and her dedication to her position was very much appreciated. Many happy and healthy years of retirement were wished her when she left.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.
